Raspberry Pi Midi Desktop Case

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2215124-raspberry-pi-midi-desktop-case?from=search#profileId-2408288

Midi‑Sized 3D‑Printed Raspberry Pi Case 

A compact, performance‑ready enclosure built for serious Pi projects.

 

This midi‑sized 3D‑printed Raspberry Pi case is designed for makers who want a sturdy, practical enclosure with real airflow and expansion capability. Printed with crisp edges and a solid, modern profile, it offers a balanced footprint that’s larger than a standard Pi case but smaller than a full desktop chassis — ideal for desk setups, small servers, or compact workstations.

 

Compatible with the Raspberry Pi 3, 4, and 5, the case features clean port access, structured internal spacing, and reinforced mounting points for reliable everyday use. The top panel supports up to two 40 mm fans, giving you flexible cooling for high‑performance workloads, clusters, or sustained processing tasks.

 

Ventilation slots along the sides and top improve airflow, while the bold, durable PLA construction provides a premium feel without unnecessary weight. The layout is engineered for tidy cable routing and easy maintenance, making it a practical choice for both hobbyists and advanced Pi users.

 

A robust, airflow‑focused enclosure that keeps your Raspberry Pi cool, organised, and ready for demanding projects.

No Glue required, simple to setup.

 

All Raspberry Pi Ports are accessible. Ethernet and USB through the front (or rear) of the case and HDMI, USB Power and Audio jack are accessible through the side of the case.

 

Panels are interchangeable, allowing you to alter the setup to suit your own requirements.

 

REQUIRED:

8 x M2.5*6 Self Tapping Screws

4 x M2.5 6mm Bolts

4 x M2.5 12mm Male to Female Hex Spacers

 

OPTIONAL

40mm Fan

0.96&#34; OLED Display

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#DE4343), PLA (#0078BF)
